name: Source-bounded Claims
standard: Every factual claim traces to supplied or retrieved evidence; unknowns remain unknown.
test: Extract claims from outputs, map each to evidence, and mark unsupported or over-broad claims as failures.

metric.name: unsupported_claim_rate
metric.unit: unsupported factual claims divided by all scored factual claims

claim_boundary: Passing a source fixture does not establish truth beyond the cited source set.
